_comment: accounts: the show's official X handles without the @ (none confirmed yet). weak: keywords that are also everyday words or common names; they only count with a context word, a second keyword, or on an air night. context: show vocabulary that backs up a weak keyword but never covers on its own. aliases: show names and hashtags that never change. people: names that matter every season (the host). seasons: one per season; that season's cast goes in people, named twists and season hashtags in terms. episodes: the date it FIRST airs in the US (New Blood: NBC Thursday 8 PM ET; Peacock is the next day), oldest first. Two episodes on the same night are ONE entry ("Episodes 1 & 2"): Plot Armor draws its line by date and keeps a two-episode night covered until both are ticked, so one entry reads more simply in the popup. The finale gets "kind": "event". New Blood dates from NBC's schedule, titles and cast from Wikipedia (Nov 2026). Next: the celebrity season (Peacock, early 2027) once its date is announced. Then run npm test. Never delete or rename an episode id (users have ticked it); to remove one on purpose, also add its id to a "removedEpisodes" list, or the extension refuses the file.
